text:
Aisha N.: quick heads-up — HelioPay asked for a compact enablement run this week. They want hands-on migration + dedicated q&a for billing scale. Can we fit 3 sessions over next 7 days?
Marco Li: dates/slots? timezone: PST primary but they have EU PMs as backup
Jules K.: I'm out Thur morning, but can do Mon/Tue/Wed afternoons PST
Priya R.: I can lead the hands-on part (dedicated migration). Available Tue/Wed 12–3pm PST
Samir H.: I can do Wed 5pm PST / Thu 10am CET. Prefer Wed
Aisha N.: sweet — priority is 2hr workshop for engineers + 45m executive recap. Proposed slots:
- Tue 2025-03-11 13:00–15:00 PST (eng workshop)
- Wed 2025-03-12 17:00–17:45 PST (exec recap)
- Thu 2025-03-13 08:00–10:00 CET (extra hands-on)
Marco Li: I'm good for Tue and Wed slot. Thu CET is tight but can cover first hour
OnboardBot: availability poll created: https://polls.redwood.com/heliopay-enable — poll closes in 36h
Priya R.: prework idea: ask them to run `ri infer --model small --sample 50` against prod-like dataset and bring logs. Short checklist in the invite
Aisha N.: yes — add prework + a short eval set so we can demo regressions quickly. Samir can you draft the checklists?
Samir H.: will do. I'll drop a 1-page checklist + quick runbook link by EOD
Jules K.: can someone add the renewal risk note? If HelioPay completes workshops and passes the eval, renewal likelihood jumps — exec recap should include roadmap + pricing options
Aisha N.: noted. I'll add a slide: 'enablement -> renewal signal' with KPIs
Marco Li: logistics — capacity 12 seats for hands-on. We should limit to 2 per customer team. Also request their config snapshots ahead of time
Priya R.: suggest we record the hands-on and tag snippets for future CS playbook
Aisha N.: perfect. After poll closes, I'll finalize invites and route to AMs. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:
